metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully filled the background layer with green color in GIMP. Steps: selected Background layer, opened foreground color dialog, set color to green, used Edit > Fill with FG Color, saved the file. Completed in 13 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select layers in GIMP layers panel, change foreground color via color dialog, use Edit menu fill operations, save files with Ctrl+S
metadata.task_rationale: Different GIMP operation (resize) at similar difficulty. Original image is 800x800, task requires scaling to 400x400 via Image > Scale Image menu. Tests model's ability to use GIMP's resize functionality.
metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing the 800x800 image to 400x400 pixels. Postconfig exports the result as PNG. Official check_image_size metric verifies the exported image dimensions match 400x400.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires resizing image to 400x400 pixels; evaluator checks exactly width=400 and height=400 via check_image_size metric — complete coverage.
Postconfig correctly exports the image from GIMP using Shift+Ctrl+E (Export As), types a filename, and confirms the export dialog, ensuring the resized image is saved as PNG.
Getter vm_file correctly fetches the exported file /home/user/Desktop/resized_output.png and passes the local path to the metric.
Metric function check_image_size receives the rules dict directly (width, height) as the 'rule' parameter, which matches the expected.type='rule' framework behavior — parameter handling is correct.
Expected values (width: 400, height: 400) are semantically correct and match the instruction requirements exactly.
